# JinjaReportPy

Programmatic document and report generator with dynamic sections, custom CSS, and PDF export using Jinja2.

## Context

JinjaReportPy is a Python library for generating professional multi-page reports and documents (invoices, quotes, receipts, delivery notes) with:
- Dynamic sections using Jinja2 templates
- Predefined formats (default, corporate, minimal)
- Email-ready inline HTML
- PDF export via WeasyPrint
- Centralized configuration management

## Tech Stack

| Component | Technology | Version |
|-----------|------------|---------|
| Language | Python | 3.10–3.13 |
| Template Engine | Jinja2 | ≥3.1.0 |
| PDF Export | WeasyPrint | ≥60.0 (optional) |
| DataFrame Support | Pandas | ≥2.0.0 (optional) |
| GUI Viewer | tkinterweb | ≥3.0.0 (optional) |
| Build System | Hatchling | - |
| Testing | pytest | ≥8.0.0 |
| Linting | Ruff | ≥0.4.0 |
| Type Checking | mypy | ≥1.0.0 |

## Project Structure

```
jinjareportpy/                    # Project root
├── jinjareportpy/                # 📦 Main package
│   ├── __init__.py            # Public API exports
│   ├── __main__.py            # Module entry point
│   ├── cli/                   # CLI package
│   │   ├── __init__.py        # Re-exports for backward compatibility
│   │   ├── base.py            # CLIBase reusable class, CLIConfig, Subcommand
│   │   ├── commands.py        # CLI command handlers, parser, main()
│   │   └── output.py          # Colored terminal output utilities
│   ├── config.py              # Configuration management (JinjaReportConfig)
│   ├── base.py                # BaseDocument abstract class
│   ├── document.py            # Document class, data classes + factory functions
│   ├── report.py              # Report class (multi-page)
│   ├── page.py                # Page class
│   ├── sections.py            # Section classes (Header, Footer, Table, KPI, Text) — sandboxed Jinja2
│   ├── builder.py             # ReportBuilder fluent API
│   ├── assets.py              # Asset management (Base64 conversion) — path-traversal safe
│   ├── filters.py             # Jinja2 custom filters
│   ├── pdf.py                 # PDF export utilities (zoom, optimize_images)
│   ├── viewer.py              # Browser/PDF viewer integration (auto-cleanup)
│   ├── exceptions.py          # Custom exceptions
│   ├── templates/             # Built-in HTML templates
│   │   ├── base.html, report.html, invoice.html, quote.html, receipt.html, delivery_note.html
│   ├── formats/               # Predefined formats
│   │   ├── default/, corporate/, minimal/
│   └── output/                # Generated files (auto-created)
├── examples/                  # Usage examples
├── tests/                     # Unit tests (assets, builder, cli, config, document, filters, generator, pdf, report, viewer)
├── pyproject.toml            # Project metadata
└── README.md
```

## Configuration

### Priority Resolution (highest to lowest)

1. **Environment Variables** - `JINJAREPORT_*`
2. **Programmatic** - `JinjaReportConfig.set_*()`
3. **Config File** - `jinjareportpy.toml`
4. **Default Values**

### Environment Variables

| Variable | Description | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `JINJAREPORT_TEMPLATES_DIR` | Templates directory | `./templates` |
| `JINJAREPORT_FORMATS_DIR` | Formats directory | `./formats` |
| `JINJAREPORT_OUTPUT_DIR` | Output directory | `./output` |
| `JINJAREPORT_ASSETS_DIR` | Assets directory | `./assets` |
| `JINJAREPORT_DEFAULT_FORMAT` | Default format | `default` |
| `JINJAREPORT_PAGE_SIZE` | Page size (A4, A3, LETTER, LEGAL) | `A4` |
| `JINJAREPORT_ORIENTATION` | Orientation (portrait, landscape) | `portrait` |
| `JINJAREPORT_LOCALE` | Locale for formatting | `es_ES` |
| `JINJAREPORT_PDF_ZOOM` | PDF zoom level | `1.0` |
| `JINJAREPORT_PDF_OPTIMIZE_IMAGES` | Optimize images in PDF | `true` |
| `JINJAREPORT_CONFIG_FILE` | Path to TOML config file | - |

### Config File (jinjareportpy.toml)

```toml
[paths]
templates_dir = "./my_templates"
formats_dir = "./my_formats"
output_dir = "./reports"
assets_dir = "./assets"

[report]
default_format = "corporate"
page_size = "A4"
orientation = "portrait"
locale = "es_ES"

[pdf]
zoom = 1.0
optimize_images = true
```

## CLI Interface

```bash
python -m jinjareportpy [command] [options]
# or after install:
jinjareportpy [command] [options]
```

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `config show` | Show current configuration |
| `config show --json` | Output config as JSON |
| `config set <key> <value>` | Set configuration value |
| `config reset` | Reset to defaults |
| `config init` | Create jinjareportpy.toml |
| `config init --force` | Overwrite existing config file |
| `demo` | Generate demo report |
| `demo --format corporate` | Demo with specific format |
| `demo --pdf --open` | Generate PDF and open |
| `formats` | List available formats |
| `formats --details` | Show format files |
| `templates` | List available templates |
| `invoice -n <number>` | Generate invoice |
| `quote -n <number> [--validity N]` | Generate quote (validity in days) |
| `receipt -n <number> [--amount N] [--concept]` | Generate receipt |
| `delivery -n <number>` | Generate delivery note |

Common document flags: `--company`, `--client`, `-o/--output`, `--pdf`, `--open`.

## Functions & Public API

### Core Classes

```python
from jinjareportpy import Report, Document, Page, Section
from jinjareportpy import TableSection, KPISection, TextSection, HeaderSection, FooterSection
from jinjareportpy import ReportBuilder, quick_report  # Fluent API
from jinjareportpy import HeaderConfig, FooterConfig, TableConfig, KPIConfig, TextConfig  # Builder configs
from jinjareportpy import PageLayout, ReportLayout  # Layout definitions
from jinjareportpy import ReportConfig, PageSize, Orientation  # Config types
from jinjareportpy import AssetManager, register_default_filters  # Utilities
from jinjareportpy import check_weasyprint_available  # PDF availability check
from jinjareportpy import JinjaReportError, TemplateNotFoundError, AssetNotFoundError, ExportError
```

### Document Data Classes

```python
from jinjareportpy import PartyInfo, InvoiceData, QuoteData, ReceiptData, DeliveryNoteData

company = PartyInfo(name="Company", tax_id="B12345")
data = InvoiceData(invoice_number="INV-001", company=company, client=PartyInfo(name="Client"), items=[...])
```

### Document Factory Functions

```python
from jinjareportpy import create_invoice, create_quote, create_receipt, create_delivery_note

invoice = create_invoice(
    invoice_number="INV-001",
    company={"name": "Company", "tax_id": "123"},
    client={"name": "Client"},
    items=[{"description": "Service", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 100}],
)
invoice.export_pdf("invoice.pdf")
```

### ReportBuilder (Fluent API)

```python
from jinjareportpy import ReportBuilder

builder = (
    ReportBuilder("Sales Report", format_name="corporate")
    .header(title="Q4 Report", subtitle="2025")
    .footer(left="Company", right="Page 1")
    .add_kpis("metrics", [{"label": "Sales", "value": "€50K", "change": 15}])
    .add_table("data", headers=["A", "B"], rows=[["1", "2"]])
    .add_text("notes", "Additional notes")
)
builder.export_pdf("report.pdf")
```

### Configuration Functions

```python
from jinjareportpy import (
    JinjaReportConfig,
    set_output_dir, get_output_dir,
    set_assets_dir, get_assets_dir,
    set_locale, get_locale,
    set_page_size, get_page_size,
    set_orientation, get_orientation,
    set_templates_dir, get_templates_dir,
    set_formats_dir, get_formats_dir,
)

set_output_dir("./reports")
set_locale("en_US")
config = JinjaReportConfig.get_all_config()
JinjaReportConfig.reset()
```

### Format Management

```python
from jinjareportpy import set_default_format, get_default_format, get_available_formats

print(get_available_formats())  # ['corporate', 'default', 'minimal']
set_default_format("corporate")
```

### Viewer Utilities

```python
from jinjareportpy import open_in_browser, open_pdf_viewer

open_in_browser("report.html")  # Open in default browser
open_pdf_viewer("report.pdf")   # Open PDF viewer

# Additional viewer functions via submodule:
# from jinjareportpy.viewer import ReportViewer, get_viewer, reset_viewer
# from jinjareportpy.viewer import open_in_new_window, open_in_new_tab, get_available_browsers
```

### CLI Output Helpers (submodule)

```python
# Available via submodule import (not in top-level __all__):
from jinjareportpy.cli.output import (
    Colors, cprint, print_success, print_error, print_warning, print_info,
    print_header, print_table, print_summary, print_progress, confirm_action,
)

# Reusable CLI base class for building custom CLIs:
from jinjareportpy.cli.base import CLIBase, CLIConfig, Subcommand, create_cli

# Or import from the cli package directly:
from jinjareportpy.cli import CLIBase, Colors, cprint
```

## Development Workflow

```bash
# Install dependencies
uv sync

# Install with optional features
uv sync --extra pdf      # PDF support
uv sync --extra pandas   # DataFrame support
uv sync --extra gui      # GUI viewer (tkinterweb)
uv sync --extra all      # All features
uv sync --extra dev      # Development tools

# Run tests
uv run pytest
uv run pytest --cov=jinjareportpy

# Type checking
uv run mypy jinjareportpy

# Linting
uv run ruff check jinjareportpy
uv run ruff format jinjareportpy

# Run demo
python -m jinjareportpy demo --format corporate

# Generate document
python -m jinjareportpy invoice -n INV-001
```

## Technical Rules & Conventions

### Architecture

- **BaseDocument (ABC)** → Parent class for Document and Report
- **Document** → Template-based single documents (invoices, quotes)
- **Report** → Multi-page reports with sections
- **Section** → Modular content blocks with template + data + CSS

### Security

- **Template rendering**: Both `Document` and `Section` classes use `jinja2.sandbox.SandboxedEnvironment` to prevent SSTI (inline and file-based templates)
- **Asset resolution**: `AssetManager.find_asset()` rejects absolute paths and `..` traversal — all assets must reside within configured asset directories
- **Filter safety**: Non-numeric values in `format_number`/`format_percentage` and unparseable dates in `format_date` are logged via `logging.warning`
- **Temp file cleanup**: `ReportViewer.cleanup()` removes temp HTML files; `open_content()` generates unique filenames (UUID suffix) to prevent collisions and data leaks between concurrent processes; the default viewer auto-cleans via `atexit`
- **PDF error logging**: `html_to_pdf` logs full traceback via `logger.exception` before raising `PDFExportError`
- **Config file discovery**: Priority is env var `JINJAREPORT_CONFIG_FILE` → CWD `jinjareportpy.toml` → package-relative default
- **Locale-aware filters**: `format_number`/`format_currency` resolve separator defaults from `JinjaReportConfig.get_locale()` instead of hardcoded values

### Coding Standards

- Python 3.10+ with type hints
- PEP 8 style (enforced by Ruff)
- Dataclasses for configuration objects
- Custom exceptions from `exceptions.py`
- Factory pattern for document creation

### Naming Conventions

| Type | Convention | Example |
|------|------------|---------|
| Classes | PascalCase | `ReportBuilder`, `TableSection` |
| Functions | snake_case | `create_invoice`, `set_output_dir` |
| Constants | UPPER_CASE | `_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR` |
| Private | Leading underscore | `_templates_dir`, `_ensure_loaded()` |
| Config getters/setters | `get_*/set_*` | `get_locale()`, `set_locale()` |

### File Organization

- Templates: `jinjareportpy/templates/*.html`
- Formats: `jinjareportpy/formats/{name}/{component}.html|css`
- Output: `jinjareportpy/output/` (auto-created, portable)

## Key Endpoints/Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `__init__.py` | Public API exports |
| `cli/commands.py` | CLI parser, `main()` entry point, `cmd_*` handlers |
| `cli/base.py` | `CLIBase` reusable class, `CLIConfig`, `Subcommand`, `create_cli` |
| `cli/output.py` | Colored output helpers (Colors, cprint, print_*) |
| `config.py` | `JinjaReportConfig` class, getters/setters |
| `document.py` | `Document` class, data classes (PartyInfo, InvoiceData, etc.), factory functions |
| `report.py` | `Report` class for multi-page reports |
| `builder.py` | `ReportBuilder` fluent API |
| `sections.py` | Section classes (Table, KPI, Text, Header, Footer) |
| `base.py` | `BaseDocument` abstract base class |
| `assets.py` | `AssetManager` — Base64 conversion, CSS reading |
| `filters.py` | Jinja2 custom filters (currency, dates, numbers) |
| `pdf.py` | PDF export via WeasyPrint |
| `viewer.py` | `ReportViewer`, browser/PDF viewer integration |
| `exceptions.py` | Custom exceptions hierarchy |
| `formats/__init__.py` | Format loading and management |
| `templates/report.html` | Multi-page report template |
| `templates/invoice.html` | Invoice template |
| `templates/quote.html` | Quote template |
| `templates/receipt.html` | Receipt template |
| `templates/delivery_note.html` | Delivery note template |

## Class Hierarchy

```
BaseDocument (ABC)
├── render() → str
├── render_css() → str
├── render_content() → str (abstract)
├── get_base_css() → str
├── export_html(path) → Path
├── export_pdf(path) → Path
├── preview() → Path
├── preview_pdf() → Path
├── preview_embedded() → Any
└── create_viewer_form() → Any

├── Document
│   └── Template-based documents (invoice, quote, receipt, delivery_note)
│
└── Report
    ├── add_page() → Page
    ├── get_page(index) → Page
    ├── pages: list[Page]
    └── global_css: str
        │
        └── Page
            ├── set_header() / set_footer()
            ├── add_section(Section)
            ├── render() → str
            ├── render_css() → str
            └── sections: list[Section]
                │
                └── Section (and subclasses)
                    ├── TableSection
                    ├── KPISection
                    ├── TextSection
                    ├── HeaderSection
                    └── FooterSection

ReportBuilder
├── header() / footer()
├── add_table() / add_kpis() / add_text()
├── add_section(Section) → ReportBuilder
├── css(str) → ReportBuilder
├── build() → Report
├── render() → str
├── render_inline() → str
├── to_clipboard_html() → str
├── export_html(path) → Path
├── export_pdf(path) → Path
├── preview() → Path
└── from_data_layout(data, layout) → str  (classmethod)
```

## Quick Reference

```python
# Document (single page)
from jinjareportpy import create_invoice
invoice = create_invoice(invoice_number="INV-001", company={...}, client={...}, items=[...])
invoice.export_pdf("invoice.pdf")

# Report (multi-page)
from jinjareportpy import ReportBuilder
builder = ReportBuilder("Title").header(title="Header").add_table("t", headers=[], rows=[])
builder.export_html("report.html")

# Configuration
from jinjareportpy import set_output_dir, set_locale
set_output_dir("./reports")
set_locale("en_US")

# CLI
# python -m jinjareportpy demo --format corporate --pdf --open
```
